messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

Why are you moved, since you are mortal?","verse":15},{"chapter":7,"text":"Why havenâ€™t you considered in your mind that which is to come, rather than that which is present?â€‌","verse":16},{"chapter":7,"text":"Then I answered and said, â€œO sovereign Lord, behold, you have ordained in your law that the righteous will inherit these things, but that the ungodly will perish.","verse":17},{"chapter":7,"text":"The righteous therefore will suffer difficult things, and hope for easier things, but those who have done wickedly have suffered the difficult things, and yet will not see the easier things.â€‌","verse":18},{"chapter":7,"text":"He said to me, â€œYou are not a judge above God, neither do you have more understanding than the Most High.","verse":19},{"chapter":7,"text":"Yes, let many perish who now live, rather than that the law of God which is set before them be despised.","verse":20}],"book_code":"2ES"}
